name: Product Search
description: User searches for a product using the main search box and initiates the search.
steps: Locate the search_box element.
Enter the product name or keywords into the search_box.
Locate and click the search_button.
Wait for the search results page to load.

name: User Sign‑In
description: Existing user logs into their Flipkart account via the sign‑in button.
steps: Locate and click the sign_in_button.
Wait for the login modal to appear.
Enter email/phone number and password.
Submit the login form.
Verify that the account_button appears, indicating a successful login.

name: Add Product to Cart
description: User selects a product from search or category results and adds it to the shopping cart.
steps: Perform a product search or navigate via navigation_menu to a category.
Locate a product_links element for the desired item and click it.
On the product detail page, locate the 'Add to Cart' button (not provided in hints, but assumed present).
Click the 'Add to Cart' button.
Confirm that the cart_button shows the updated item count.

name: View Cart and Proceed to Checkout
description: User opens the cart to review items and initiates the checkout process.
steps: Locate and click the cart_button.
Wait for the cart page to load and verify listed items.
Click the 'Place Order' or 'Proceed to Checkout' button (assumed present on cart page).
Verify navigation to the address/checkout page.

name: Browse Daily Deals
description: User navigates to the deals/offers section to view discounted products.
steps: Locate and click the deals_link.
Wait for the deals page to load.
Optionally scroll through deal tiles and capture product information.

name: Navigate Through Top Categories
description: User uses the top navigation menu to explore different product categories.
steps: Locate the navigation_menu container.
Select a category link within the menu (e.g., Electronics, Fashion).
Click the chosen category link.
Wait for the category listing page to load.

name: Access Account Options
description: After signing in, user opens the account dropdown to manage profile, orders, or logout.
steps: Locate and click the account_button.
Wait for the dropdown menu to appear.
Select an option such as 'My Orders', 'Profile', or 'Logout'.
Verify the resulting page or action.
